paragraphs.text: The Anthologies of Magic is a set of five anthologies containing a disparate set of storylines that took place in a wide range of time periods randing from ancient Mythohistory to the early part of the Rift Era . Although there is no single continuous story or specifically recurring character across books, the anthologies share a thematic composition which each book having a specific theme that the stories align behind, and all books contain charcters that also show up in the main storyline.
